# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the public-safe change.

## Scope

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository map / relationship model
- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Promotion or community material
- [ ] Other public-safe change

## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, cookies, OAuth state, or account state.
- [ ] No private configuration, private bookmarks, personal memory, local paths, or browser/session data.
- [ ] No copied third-party content body unless redistribution is clearly permitted.
- [ ] Repository authority boundaries are not weakened.
- [ ] Public-to-private and private-to-public sync rules are not weakened.
- [ ] `python -B scripts/verify.py` passes.

## Notes

Add any public-safe context, evidence, or follow-up items.
